Antenna.poly: Maximum allowed field poly area to antenna area is 100:1. Connect diode to relax constraint.
Antenna.metal1: Maximum allowed (poly + metal 1) antenna area to gate area is 300:1. Connect diode to relax constraint.
Antenna.metal2: [Area(poly)+Area(Metal 1)]:Area(Gate) should be < 300:1 to prevent plasma induced damage.
